# Tiling report (real slides; generated by scripts/06_tiling_qc_report.py)

Slides processed: 130 / 203.

## Slide size at 20x and tissue tiles (224 px, stride 224, >= 50% tissue)

- Width x height at 20x: median 16249 x 14320 px (max 16250 x 16250).
- Tissue tiles per slide: median 1891, IQR 1456-2244, range 269-3067.
- Slides truncated by a max_tiles cap: 256: 100%, 1024: 88%, 2048: 35%, 4096: 0%, 8192: 0%.

| Subtype | Slides | Min | Median | Max |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| In situ | 28 | 269 | 1423 | 2197 |
| Lepidic | 1 | 1913 | 1913 | 1913 |
| Acinar | 7 | 1471 | 1965 | 2037 |
| Papillary | 34 | 428 | 1788 | 2842 |
| Micropapillary | 20 | 1179 | 2140 | 3067 |
| Solid | 26 | 1320 | 2198 | 2978 |
| Cribriform | 14 | 687 | 1978 | 2662 |

## Timing (this run)

- Download: median 8.3 s/slide; decode at 20x: median 17.4 s; tissue mask + grid: median 1.0 s.
- Encoder time per tile on this hardware: phikonv2 191 ms, phikon 55 ms, lunit_dino 17 ms.

## Projection for the headline run (Kaggle 2x T4, cap 4096)

- Tiles to embed with cap 4096: 235,266 (vs 33,280 in this pilot).
- CPU-side decode for 203 slides: ~1.0 h, overlapped with encoding by the decode-ahead thread.
- GPU encode time depends on T4 throughput (not measurable here); the stage-1 notebook prints per-model tiles/s after the 2-slide smoke test, and `--summarize` totals them.
